title: Emmy Noether: Modern LaTeX Drafts and English Translation Working Drafts
version: 2026-06-01 current Noether author record: numbered Papers 1-43 complete and audited
description:
Author record for Emmy Noether in the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This record keeps earlier broad working readers while a paper-by-paper source-and-translation edition replaces them.

Status at a glance. [##########] numbered-paper stream: Papers 1-43 complete and audited in paired original German and English readers; [##########] source-scan witnesses, TeX, audit material, and build reports preserved. Front matter and post-numbered material are registered in artifacts but are not included in the numbered-paper cumulative readers.

Latest update. The final numbered-paper audit restores the Paper 34 product table in both cumulative readers and exposes standalone restoration PDFs for checking.
notes: Latest update promotes the final audited numbered-paper cumulative readers for Papers 1-43 and restores the Paper 34 product table.
